targets.query: default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])), requests=count() by agent=tostring(resource['berserk.agent.profile']), harness=tostring(resource['berserk.harness.version']) | sort by cost_usd desc | take 40

default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | summarize input_tokens=sum(toint(attributes['input_tokens'])), cache_read_tokens=sum(toint(attributes['cache_read_tokens'])) by agent=tostring(resource['berserk.agent.profile']) | extend cache_hit_ratio=cache_read_tokens/(input_tokens+cache_read_tokens) | sort by cache_hit_ratio asc

default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | summarize requests=countif(attributes['event.name'] == 'api_request'), errors=countif(attributes['event.name'] == 'api_error' or tostring(attributes['error']) == 'true'), attempts=sum(toint(attributes['attempt'])) by agent=tostring(resource['berserk.agent.profile']), harness=tostring(resource['berserk.harness.version']) | sort by errors desc | take 40

default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])), successes=countif(attributes['event.name'] == 'api_request') by agent=tostring(attributes['agent.name']), harness=tostring(resource['berserk.harness.version']) | extend cost_per_success=cost_usd/successes | sort by cost_per_success desc | take 50

panels.title: Expensive MCP operations and large results

targets.query: default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where attributes['event.name'] == 'tool_result' | summarize calls=count(), failures=countif(tostring(attributes['success']) == 'false'), result_bytes=sum(toint(attributes['tool_result_size_bytes'])) by mcp_server=tostring(attributes['mcp_server.name']), operation=tostring(attributes['mcp_tool.name']) | sort by result_bytes desc | take 50

panels.title: Compaction and retry pressure by harness

targets.query: default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | summarize compactions=countif(attributes['event.name'] == 'compaction'), retry_exhaustions=countif(attributes['event.name'] == 'api_retries_exhausted') by day=bin(timestamp, 1d), harness=tostring(resource['berserk.harness.version']) | sort by day asc | take 2000

default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where attributes['event.name'] == 'api_request' | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])), requests=count(), duration_ms=sum(todouble(attributes['duration_ms'])) by agent=tostring(attributes['agent.name']), harness=tostring(resource['berserk.harness.version']), recommendation=tostring(resource['berserk.recommendation.id']) | extend cost_per_request=cost_usd/requests, avg_duration_ms=duration_ms/requests | sort by agent asc | take 100
